title: Performance budget: sub-2s first meaningful paint on 3G-fast, Lighthouse 90+, main-thread under 3s
description: On the 3G-fast reference profile, first meaningful paint lands under 2 seconds. Lighthouse performance scores at least 90 on the declared key routes. Total main-thread work during initial load stays under 3 seconds. The budget is enforced against production builds, not development servers.
rationale: A stated budget converts performance from a mood into a gate. The reference profile and thresholds are the ratified quality bar.
